title: Renaissance Technologies
summary: They say there’s no persistence of returns for hedge funds, that this year’s big winner can be next year’s big loser, and that nobody gets huge outperformance without taking huge risk. Ben: It’s honestly crazy that this group of people took this type of risk. Blow up risk is always an issue in the markets, but this happened to RenTech.
